description: The National Statistical Office of Malawi publishes the 2018 Population and Housing Census tables as Excel series through its content server. Series I, housing and household tables, has 33 tables by region and district. They give housing units and population by permanent, semi-permanent or traditional dwelling type, occupancy and rooms, and households by main energy for lighting, including electricity and solar, and for cooking and heating. Drinking water source is tabulated separately for the dry and the wet season, which is useful for water security. Other tables cover toilet type, assets and internet access, and waste disposal. The households and living conditions report adds chapters on wall, roof and floor materials, and states that about 11 percent of households used electricity for lighting. A separate thematic report covers water and sanitation, and census reports are published for individual districts. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration; the website is a JavaScript app, but the download links work directly. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: some series are also mirrored on HDX, but Series I was not among the HDX files. Simulation uses: seasonal water sources and lighting energy by district for rural electrification and water planning. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.
